description: A signed numeric literal as a DISPLAY operand — a COBOL-2002 relaxation of a COBOL-85 restriction, QUOTED from ISO/IEC 1989:2002 Annex F.2 item 46: "DISPLAY statement. If the literal in a DISPLAY statement is numeric, it may be signed." COBOL-85 is the edition a 2002 Annex F.2 'formerly' statement describes: the owner's decision of 2026-10-31 (kb/Work PB4305) makes the F.2 statements the rule for the 85 edge, as D-SIGN2 (item 124) and PB3683 (item 123) did; GnuCOBOL -std=cobol85 accepts some of them as dialect leniency, which rule 1 places below the ISO text. Gated in ONE place, VersionConformancePass.ParseArm.VisitDisplayStatement, once per signed literal operand (kb/Work PB4305; VCR row 7.47).
display: a signed numeric literal as a DISPLAY operand
